entries.english:
Rosenberg

Date range: 1550–c. 1610

Contents include: Hans Charius von Rosenberg acknowledges receipt of his burgh levy (1567); documents concerning a dispute between Joachim von Niedeck zu Eubigheim and Lorenz von Rosenberg (disputed venue: the territorial court of the Duchy of Franconia, Würzburg (1550)).

Extent: 7 documents
